title: Inverse image of a lisse coefficient module along any scheme morphism
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $h:T\to S$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Put $\Lambda_S=p_S^*\Lambda$ and $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and the module inverse image $h^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_h}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(h^*_{\Ab})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Let $M$ be a $\Lambda_S$-module, $\{u_i:U_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ a pro-etale covering, and $\tau_i:M|_{U_i}\cong(\Lambda_S|_{U_i})^{r_i}$ isomorphisms on the slice sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] with $r_i\in\mathbf N$. Then the base changes $\{U_i\times_ST\to T\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fibre-product] form a pro-etale covering of $T$, and for every $i$ there is an isomorphism $(h^*M)|_{U_i\times_ST}\cong(\Lambda_T|_{U_i\times_ST})^{r_i}$ on the slice site of $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ at $U_i\times_ST$, with the same $r_i$. In particular, if $M$ is lisse [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module] then so is $h^*M$. Rank zero and empty schemes are allowed; no Noetherian, finiteness or flatness hypothesis is imposed on $h$ or $\Lambda$.

source.place: (2): the base change of a trivializing cover is a cover on which the restriction is free of the same rank, since pullback preserves the coefficient ring (sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients) and direct sums; stated here for an arbitrary commutative condensed ring and an arbitrary morphism.

proof.text: The base-changed family is a pro-etale cover by the base-change stability instance for Scheme.proetalePrecoverage. Apply Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback to the given family and the flipped chosen pullback squares. This simultaneously uses fpqc and weakly etale base-change stability and works for an empty family.

proof.text: Put F=InternalModuleOperations.siteMap h, a=coefficientMap Lambda h and N=E_S(M). The upperComparison isomorphism identifies E_T(h^*M) with the sectionwise upperStar of N. The latter and Mathlib SheafOfModules.pullback a are left adjoints of the same direct image; Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq identifies them. Restrict both isomorphisms to F(U_i).

proof.text: Use the universe-general localization comparison localLeftIso. F preserves finite limits and coverings, so local_continuous supplies continuity of Over.post F on the slice sites. Its coefficient map b=locMap a U_i is the restriction of a. The global adjunction is supplied by internal-module transport; the slice adjoint exists by module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes. Thus restriction of pullback is isomorphic to pullback of N restricted to U_i, with the restricted target coefficient ring.

proof.text: Over.post F preserves finite limits, hence is representably flat and final. Apply the localized module pullback to the given tau_i and compose with Mathlib SheafOfModules.pullbackObjFreeIso b (ULift (Fin (r_i))). This library isomorphism preserves the given basis index and includes the empty index. Composing with the isomorphisms of Steps 2 and 3 proves the required specified slice trivialization.

proof.text: For the lisse corollary, use the already proved auxiliary CondensedRing.locFree_pullback in the module of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-locally-free-models]. Its LocFree abbreviation is definitionally the existing IsLisseCoefficientModule predicate: a pro-etale scheme cover with finite-free pullbacks. The lemma base changes that cover, transports free modules by inverse image and the invertible coefficient map, and uses upperStarComp and the pullback-square equation to identify the restrictions. Apply it directly with Lambda.X, h and M. This proof includes the zero-rank and empty cases and imposes no extra hypotheses.

lean.statement: theorem lisseModuleInverseImage_trivializations (Λ : Profinite.CondensedRing.{u}) [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] {T S : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ.X S)) {I : Type v} (U : I → S.ProEt) (_hU : Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (U i).left) (fun i ↦ (U i).hom) ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage S) (r : I → ℕ) (_τ : ∀ i : I, ((sectionModuleFunctor (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) (condensedRingObj Λ.X S)).obj M).over (U i) ≅ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u + 1} (Fin (r i)))) : (Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ pullback (U i).hom h) (fun i ↦ pullback.snd (U i).hom h) ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage T) ∧ ∀ i : I, Nonempty (((sectionModuleFunctor (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ.X T)).obj ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ.X h).obj M)).over (Scheme.ProEt.mk (pullback.snd (U i).hom h)) ≅ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u + 1} (Fin (r i))))
